entries.title: Updated Behaviours for Multi-Device Responsiveness
entries.summary: Full responsive audit, layout repair, and mobile/tablet standardisation across all 9 target viewports (320px - 1920px).
entries.description: Resolved all root-cause layout overflow and mobile clipping defects across Overview, Typography, Colors, Components, Patterns, and Changelog modules. Established unified responsive standards with fluid container clamping, mobile navigation drawer ergonomics, single-column preview reflow, and WCAG 2.2 AA target size compliance.
changes: Audited and verified 0 horizontal overflow across all 9 target viewports from 320px small mobile to 1920px wide desktop.
Repaired global header overflow by adding responsive breakpoint rules, compact logo handling, and hiding oversized taglines on mobile.
Standardised fluid section padding clamp(28px, 5vw, 64px) clamp(16px, 4vw, 40px) and flexible container constraints (.in).
Refactored component and pattern explorer previews to automatically stack to single-column on screens <= 768px with full width containment.
Enclosed category architecture tables and data grids in touch-friendly horizontal scroll containers (.tb) preventing container blowout.
Updated touch target sizes to minimum 40px for mobile buttons, drawer navigation links, and interactive controls matching WCAG 2.2 AA.
entries.commitMessage: feat(responsive): updated behaviours for multi device responsiveness

entries.title: Repair Complex Data Components & Interaction Lifecycle
entries.summary: Repaired behaviour, state lifecycles, and visual representations for Column Visibility Menu, Editable Cell, Filter Builder, and Data Grid.
entries.description: Resolved root-cause generic table fallback by implementing dedicated component controllers, type-aware query builders, in-place cell editing state machines, and a unified Phase 3 integrated scenario workflow.
changes: Implemented dedicated Column Visibility Menu with real-time column search, locked identifier protection, and live grid synchronization.
Implemented Editable Cell with complete lifecycle (View, Hover, Focus, Edit, Dirty, Saving, Saved, Validation Error) across 5 data types.
Implemented Filter Builder featuring type-aware operators, dynamic value inputs (between, enum, text), and AND/OR logic conjunctions.
Implemented Data Grid composite architecture with sorting, row selection, bulk actions, density switcher, pagination, and a 7-step integrated workflow scenario.
Added WCAG 2.2 AA compliant token bindings and side-by-side light and dark preview modes.
entries.commitMessage: fix(components): repair behaviour, states, and integration for complex data components

entries.title: Changelog Page & Update Tracking System
entries.summary: Introduced a dedicated, editorial changelog page and permanent change-tracking architecture.
entries.description: Established an evolving record of all design system updates with multi-facet filtering, summary metrics, and strict contributor guidelines for ongoing traceability.
changes: Introduced dedicated Changelog page and timeline interface integrated into main navigation.
Added multi-facet filtering by category (Features, Improvements, Fixes, Breaking, Docs), search, and version.
Added dynamic summary overview metrics calculated from single source of truth changelog.json.
Created CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md defining mandatory pre-commit changelog workflow.
Dual data-loading architecture supporting HTTP fetch and standalone offline file:/// execution.
entries.commitMessage: feat: introduce changelog page and update tracking

entries.title: Initial Meld Design System Release
entries.summary: Initial baseline release of Meld Design System by IDEO.
entries.description: Comprehensive design system containing typography, color tokens, 18 repaired core components, and 125 UX patterns across 8 categories with AI workflows.
changes: Introduced Space Grotesk typography system with primitive and semantic tokens.
Introduced WCAG 2.2 AA color tokens, OKLCH tonal scales, and dual light/dark themes.
Implemented and repaired 18 core UI components with full interactive states and Figma references.
Introduced 125 UX design patterns with interactive workflows including AI Content Generation and Human-in-the-Loop Approval.
Added global search, token copy utilities, and interactive preview sandbox.
